question: Does the exact pilot PPO task-learning signal replicate over three independently initialized training seeds?
seed_rule: first 8 hex digits of SHA256(package_name + :stage1: + index), modulo 2147483647; indices 0,1,2; generated only after this protocol is written

stage1.extension_rule: At 50 extend ALL three seeds to 80 only if at least two seeds have a higher last-10 than first-10 training completion rate, not all three have final repeated runtime success, at least 90 minutes remain before no-new-physics and >12M native steps remain. Frozen evaluation cannot choose seed/reward; no extension otherwise.

schedule: if extension episode80 deterministic twice per seed
one fixed legal plus-one control explicitly not B/H150
if Stage2 final deterministic twice against its frozen Stage1 parent
evaluation.physical_initial_state_rule: Exact historical deterministic commissioning/recovery and nominal task state; environment seed does not randomize patient or physical parameters.

replication_pass_rule: All three seeds improve from an initial deterministic runtime failure to repeated 2/2 runtime success at the final preregistered checkpoint. Otherwise report partial/not replicated, with every seed. Runtime success is not matched/full qualification.

stage2.parent_rule: smallest numerical Stage1 seed, final preregistered checkpoint; never pick best force result
stage2.gate: 3/3 replication criterion, parent repeated 2/2 runtime complete, no observed hard safety/reward/ownership defect, >60 minutes until no-new-physics and sufficient native budget; full scorer missing permits non-promotion development only
stage2.reward_design: Freeze a simple task/progress/completion + force + motion cost after Stage1 training-reward audit and before Stage2. No tuning on frozen evaluation; no reward revision branch planned.
stage2.stop_rule: Stop on observed safety/reward/ownership defect, nonfinite values, or after a block of 10 with training completion rate more than 20 percentage points below the parent last20; final frozen task failure forbids improvement claim.

unchanged_scientific_variables: 2 bounded continuous progress-fraction intents, no teacher
pilot_v3_failure_cost_floor reward and all PPO hyperparameters for Stage1
original task, absolute safety and scorer thresholds
truth_firewall: Actor uses current causal measured/estimated interface only. qpos/qvel/native and future truth are evaluation-only. No human future truth or teacher actions.

qualification.runtime: original COMPLETE, all OUTBOUND/HOLD/RETURN transitions and causal completion commit
qualification.matched: all original frozen matched task conditions; timing alone insufficient
qualification.full: original matched task+safety+motion/fairness+causal all passing; missing semantics means NOT_READY
qualification.host_realtime: NOT_EVALUABLE in scientific mode; no strict55 claim

exclusions: No task failure excluded. Infrastructure/resource interruption is PARTIAL_INFRASTRUCTURE and counts as a physical attempt, with actual completed steps, but is never relabeled a task failure or successful training episode.
train_artifacts: Every episode: compact PPO transition/rollout, terminal summary, reward parts, observed native/motion/safety/causal audit, action proposals/receipts, resources. Periodic checkpoints at initialization and every 5 completed episodes plus phase ends; complete raw for every frozen evaluation. Training native journal and large runtime raw are temporary, audited then pruned with SHA256 tombstones; failed/partial summaries and compact evidence remain.
stop_boundary: No final campaign, no next research package, no Git writes or instance changes.
